states.name: q
states.meaning: 8-bit D flip-flop output register; synchronous reset value is 0x34 (52).
states.update_time: negedge of clk after the edge has settled

rules.condition: reset == 1 on a negedge of clk; q becomes 52 (0x34) regardless of d
rules.spec_quote: The flip-flops must be reset to 0x34 rather than zero.

rules.condition: reset == 0 on a negedge of clk; q captures d
rules.spec_quote: All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first negedge where reset is sampled low

mid: Optional mid changes occur after sampling the negedge; changed values are carried to the start of the next row.
